outlooks.title: High fire-weather index forecast for Karachi, 29 Nov to 30 Nov
outlooks.issuedAtBasis: Timestamp of the numerical weather prediction model run, issued before the target window.
outlooks.confidence: This forecast covers days 5 to 6 ahead. The method was tested only on forecasts made 3 and 5 days ahead, on days from 17 Jul 2026 to 17 Oct 2026: at 5 days ahead, 66% of the days it flagged crossed the line (2% of days did anyway) and it flagged 39% of the days that crossed. Days beyond 5 ahead were not tested. The fire test forecast only the last day, an easier test than this forecast. Those are day-by-day rates; this forecast is graded on its whole window.
outlooks.details: Our own forecast, made before the period it covers. outlooks.evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-11-24, compared with NASA POWER daily records for Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
outlooks.verificationRule: Checked against the Fire Weather Index NASA POWER measured for the grid cell around Karachi on these days, once each measurement has settled (14 days): correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not.
